from textual.app import ComposeResult, App
from textual.widgets import Header, Footer, Static
from textual.binding import Binding


class LogWidget(Static):
    """A scrollable log widget."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.lines = []
    
    def append_line(self, line: str) -> None:
        """Append a line to the log."""
        self.lines.append(line)
        self.update("\n".join(self.lines))


class LogApp(App):
    """Minimal streaming log app."""
    
    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("q", "quit", "Quit"),
        Binding("l", "log", "Add line"),
    ]
    
    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        yield Header()
        yield LogWidget(id="log")
        yield Footer()
    
    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        log = self.query_one("#log", LogWidget)
        log.append_line("Log initialized")
    
    def action_log(self) -> None:
        log = self.query_one("#log", LogWidget)
        log.append_line(f"Line {len(log.lines)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    app = LogApp()
    app.run()
